why: Future Continuous показывает действие, которое будет в процессе в конкретный момент будущего: «Завтра в пять я буду ехать в поезде». Future Perfect показывает действие, которое уже завершится к определённому моменту: «К пятнице я закончу проект». В русском «буду делать» и «сделаю к...» различаются видом глагола, в английском их различают разные времена.
formation: • I will be working. / I won't be working. / Will you be working?
Future Perfect: will have + V3 (третья форма глагола)
• I will have finished. / I won't have finished. / Will you have finished?
Сокращения: I'll be working, I'll have finished, won't = will not.
usage: 1. Процесс в конкретный момент будущего: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Berlin. (Завтра в это время я буду лететь в Берлин.)
2. Объясняем, почему человек будет занят: Don't call at 8, we'll be having dinner. (Не звони в восемь, мы будем ужинать.)
3. Вежливый вопрос о планах: Will you be using the car tonight? (Вам понадобится машина вечером?)
1. Действие завершится к моменту в будущем: By Friday I will have finished the report. (К пятнице я закончу отчёт.)
2. Накопленный результат или срок: By next June they will have lived here for ten years. (К следующему июню они проживут здесь десять лет.)
Сравните: At 5 I'll be writing the report (в 5 я буду в процессе). By 5 I'll have written the report (к 5 отчёт уже будет готов).
signalWords: Future Continuous: this time tomorrow, at 8 o'clock tomorrow, all day tomorrow, next week at this time.
Future Perfect: by, by then, by the time, by the end of, before, in two years' time.
mistakes: ✗ This time tomorrow I will lie on the beach. → ✓ I will be lying on the beach. (процесс в момент будущего)
✗ I will be finish the report by five. → ✓ I will have finished the report by five. (be + V-ing и have + V3 нельзя смешивать)
✗ By the time you will arrive, I will have left. → ✓ By the time you arrive, I will have left. (после by the time и when будущее не ставим)
✗ She will have finish it by Friday. → ✓ She will have finished it by Friday. (после have нужна третья форма)
✗ Will you have using the laptop at five? → ✓ Will you be using the laptop at five? (вопрос о процессе, поэтому be + V-ing)
remember: will be doing — буду в процессе; will have done — уже закончу к тому времени.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Future Continuous или Future Perfect

items.prompt: This time tomorrow I ___ (fly) to Berlin.
items.answer: will be flying

items.prompt: By 2030 she ___ (finish) her degree.
items.answer: will have finished

items.prompt: Don't call at 8. We ___ (have) dinner.
items.answer: will be having

items.prompt: By the end of the month, I ___ (save) $1,000.
items.answer: will have saved

items.prompt: At 10 a.m. tomorrow he ___ (give) a presentation.
items.answer: will be giving

items.prompt: Next May they ___ (live) here for ten years.
items.answer: will have lived

items.prompt: Next week at this time we ___ (lie) on the beach.
items.answer: will be lying

items.prompt: I ___ (write) all the tests by Friday.
items.answer: will have written

items.prompt: Call me after six. I (a) will finish (b) will be finishing (c) will have finished work by then.
items.answer: (c) will have finished

items.prompt: Don't phone at nine. I (a) will sleep (b) will be sleeping (c) will have slept.
items.answer: (b) will be sleeping

items.prompt: By the time you arrive, we (a) will have left (b) would leave (c) will be leave.
items.answer: (a) will have left

items.prompt: This time next week, I (a) will lie (b) will have lain (c) will be lying on a beach.
items.answer: (c) will be lying

items.prompt: Hurry up! The film (a) will have started (b) will be start (c) will starting by the time we get there.
items.answer: (a) will have started

items.prompt: All day tomorrow they (a) will have worked (b) will be working (c) will worked on the migration.
items.answer: (b) will be working

items.prompt: She (a) will have graduated (b) will be graduating (c) graduates by next June.
items.answer: (a) will have graduated

items.prompt: Don't worry: when you wake up, I (a) will cook (b) will have cooked (c) will be cook breakfast, and it will be ready.
items.answer: (b) will have cooked

exercises.instruction: Составьте вопрос или отрицание, перепишите предложение

items.prompt: Make a question: You will use the car tomorrow evening.
items.answer: Will you be using the car tomorrow evening?

items.prompt: Make it negative: She will have finished the report by noon.
items.answer: She won't have finished the report by noon. / She will not have finished the report by noon.

items.prompt: Make a question: They will have arrived by 7.
items.answer: Will they have arrived by 7?

items.prompt: Make it negative: I will be working tonight.
items.answer: I won't be working tonight. / I will not be working tonight.

items.prompt: Make a question: what / you / do / at 8 tomorrow
items.answer: What will you be doing at 8 tomorrow?

items.prompt: Make a question: how many pages / he / write / by Friday
items.answer: How many pages will he have written by Friday?

items.prompt: Rewrite: I finish my project on Thursday. The deadline is Friday. (By Friday ...)
items.answer: By Friday I will have finished my project.

items.prompt: Rewrite: At 9 tomorrow we are in the air. (At 9 tomorrow we / fly)
items.answer: At 9 tomorrow we will be flying.

items.prompt: I will be finish the report by five.
items.answer: I will have finished the report by five.

items.prompt: This time tomorrow I will lie on the beach.
items.answer: This time tomorrow I will be lying on the beach.

items.prompt: She will have finish the work by Friday.
items.answer: She will have finished the work by Friday.

items.prompt: Will you have using the laptop at five?
items.answer: Will you be using the laptop at five?

items.prompt: By the time we arrive, the film will be started.
items.answer: By the time we arrive, the film will have started.

items.prompt: I'm sure he will sleeping at midnight.
items.answer: I'm sure he will be sleeping at midnight.

items.prompt: They won't have been finish the project by May.
items.answer: They won't have finished the project by May.

items.prompt: In 2030 I will working in London.
items.answer: In 2030 I will be working in London.

items.prompt: Завтра в это время я буду лететь в Лондон.
items.answer: This time tomorrow I will be flying to London.

items.prompt: К пятнице мы закончим проект.
items.answer: We will have finished the project by Friday.

items.prompt: Не звони мне в восемь, я буду ужинать.
items.answer: Don't call me at eight, I will be having dinner. / Don't call me at 8, I'll be having dinner.

items.prompt: Что ты будешь делать завтра в три часа?
items.answer: What will you be doing at three o'clock tomorrow? / What will you be doing tomorrow at three?

items.prompt: К следующему году он накопит на машину.
items.answer: By next year he will have saved enough for a car. / By next year he will have saved up enough money for a car.

items.prompt: Когда ты приедешь, я уже уйду.
items.answer: By the time you arrive, I will have left. / When you arrive, I will have already left.

items.prompt: В это время в следующем месяце я буду работать в новом офисе.
items.answer: This time next month I will be working in the new office. / This time next month I will be working in a new office.

items.prompt: Ты закончишь к шести часам?
items.answer: Will you have finished by six o'clock? / Will you have finished by six?
